sections.overview: Page hero: large heading, subheading, two CTA buttons on the left; cluster of three cover images on the right

sequences.description: Large heading 'Fresh looks, bold stories, real life', subheading paragraph, and two buttons (primary 'See case', secondary 'All stories') on the left; a stacked cluster of three cover images (hip-hop dance, family vacation, music concert) on the right — arranged as a side-by-side intro hero

sections.overview: Featured article intro: large image on the left, breadcrumbs + heading + author/date meta on the right

sequences.description: Side-by-side layout: cover image (3x2, adventure spots) on the left; on the right a breadcrumb trail (Home > Case studies), h2 heading 'Fresh looks, bold moves, real stories', and byline metadata (By Taylor Brooks, June 12 2024, 4 min read)

sections.overview: Photo gallery: centered heading + subtext, followed by a 4-column grid of 8 square images

sequences.description: Centered heading 'Style in every snapshot' and paragraph 'Peek the latest looks in action'
4-column (tablet 2-col, mobile 1-col) grid of 8 square (1x1) cover images, no captions or text

sections.overview: Testimonial tabs: switchable profile panels (portrait + name/role + quote) with a 4-item tab menu of avatars

sequences.description: Tabbed testimonial component: four switchable panels, each with a large portrait image, a name, a role, and a quote; the tab navigation is a 4-column menu where each tab shows an avatar thumbnail, name, and role (Alex Rivera, Taylor Kim, Jordan Ellis, Morgan Blake)

sections.overview: Latest articles: centered heading + subtext, then a 4-column grid of article cards (image, category tag, date, title), each linked

sequences.description: Centered heading 'Latest articles' and paragraph 'Fresh looks, bold moves'
4-column grid of 4 linked article cards, each with a top image, a category tag, a date, and a heading (Tennis style redefined / Sunkissed and effortless / Party fits that pop / Game on, style up)

sections.overview: FAQ: heading + subheading on the left, an expandable list of question/answer items on the right

sequences.description: Heading 'Got questions? We've got answers.' and subheading 'Fashion FAQs, answered fast' on the left; a list of four expandable question/answer accordion items on the right (details/summary pattern)

sections.style: dark (inverse-section, full-width background image with dark overlay)
sections.overview: Closing CTA banner: full-width background image with dark overlay, heading + subheading + single button

sequences.description: Full-width card with a background image and dark overlay; overlaid content is a heading 'Fresh looks, bold stories, real life', a subheading paragraph, and a single inverse button 'See more'
